chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Baṣrī has been transmitted by me from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr and others, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh.

key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: The author’s father as an intermediary in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْد: The named transmitter through whom these narrations are reported.
key_terms.عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَغَي: A transmission link indicating Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr and others in the chain.
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: Indicates the author’s own act of transmitting the material.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Baṣrī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports in the book transmitted through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Baṣrī. It serves as a transmission note identifying the author’s route through his father, Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, and Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr.
